title: Freya and the Inheritance
author: Kestrel Ashgrove
blurb: Lena Coldharbour, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
